content:
maura: Quick check — want to lock the webinar angle this week. Thinking something operational and concrete, not a high-level product tour.
eli: +1. customers care about numbers and concrete mitigations.
jamal: Can we center the run-of-show around a live mini-demo (cost before/after) + 15m panel QA? keeps it actionable.
sophia: Speakers: maura (product), arun (infra/runtime), and a customer (maybe Toni from Nova). Toni said yes in principle last week. arun: I can do the demo for batching + prefix cache — will need a dry-run on the same infra.
maura: Great. Toni confirmation please by EOD Fri so we can finalize promo. eli: I can draft the abstract once speakers confirmed. rough headline: "Serving LLMs: Practical Tradeoffs for Cost, Latency & Reliability" — feedback?
jamal: headline good but maybe shorter — "Practical LLM Serving: Cost, Latency, Reliability". keep SEO keywords.
sophia: Also need to think regional timing — big APAC presence, so pick a time slot that hits NA morning / EU afternoon? calendar-bot: Suggested times: Tue 09:00 PT / 17:00 BST or Wed 11:00 PT / 19:00 BST.
maura: leaning Tue 09:00 PT. team availability?
arun: Tue works. will book infra slot and reserved GPU pool for the dry-run.
eli: Draft abstract plan — 1) problem + metrics 2) demo (live) 3) customer story 4) panel QA + lead routing CTA. aim for 45m total.
jamal: For run-of-show: can we keep segments strict to avoid overruns? propose 5m intro, 10m product, 12m demo, 10m customer, 8m live Q&A.
sophia: +1. add a 3m buffer for demo failover — if demo fails, swap to recorded clip and a quick analysis.
maura: Good call. Jamal, can you own the failover clip and make sure we have a 2-min pre-recorded failover showing the same key numbers?
jamal: On it. will produce a 2-min clip and host on S3. will share link by Thu.
arun: Need a rehearsal window: Wed 11:00 PT full run with presenter mics + recording. please confirm speaker availability.
maura: Toni, can you do Wed 11? (cc: @Toni)
sophia: Also: lead routing. after the event we want MQLs to go to SDR queue A for startups and queue B for enterprise. eli: I'll add UTM tagging and a post-webinar form with the routing logic.
eli: Will create the registration form with a dropdown for company size + integration interest and hook to HubSpot. askops: ensure leads have model/infra checkbox for prioritization.
maura: Marketing assets: eli to write landing copy, sophia to design promo image (include a small latency/cost chart), jamal to clip demo gifs for social. deadline Thu 5pm.
sophia: I’ll also prepare slide 1 that includes our focal metrics (tokens/sec, $/k tokens) — need exact numbers from arun by Wed morning.
arun: sending benchmark numbers today. note: highlight batching + cache delta, not raw peak perf.
maura: Rehearsal checklist: mic check, slides in deck order, failover clip loaded, recording test, spotter for chat (sophia), HubSpot form tested.
sophia: I can be chat spotter. will triage questions and pin the top 3 to pass to panel.
jamal: Post-event assets: recording + 2-min highlight clip + demo artifact (notebook). we should have those ready within 48h.
eli: I'll prepare email nurture + a short benchmark blog that expands on the demo numbers. planning a 1-week drip.
maura: Final asks: Toni confirmation by EOD Fri, arun to provision infra and benchmarks by Wed AM, jamal to produce failover clip by Thu, eli to finish registration by Thu 5pm, sophia design assets by Thu 5pm.
calendar-bot: Event created: Tue 09:00 PT — "Practical LLM Serving — Reducing Cost & Latency". Rehearsal Wed 11:00 PT. Invites sent.
maura: Thanks all — will reconvene Thu morning for a quick sync. :thumbsup:
